notes: Access: Tier 1 (direct HTTP curl/WebFetch) blocked with 403 'Access Denied' (Akamai edge, AkamaiGHost) on both robots.txt and the department page. Tier 2 (Playwright/Chromium headless) also returned 403 Access Denied on both the homepage and the department page - same Akamai bot fingerprinting block. Fell through to Tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real browser). robots.txt (fetched successfully via Claude-in-Chrome) lists a targeted 'ClaudeBot' restriction of only 'Disallow: /*?*=*' (query-parameter URLs) plus Crawl-delay: 10 - not a full-site disallow, so not policy_opt_out; proceeded, avoided query-string URLs, used clean category paths only. Discovery: from the Home & Furniture department, the 'Home & Lifestyle' mega-menu has a dedicated CHRISTMAS column (Shop All Christmas, Christmas Bauble & Decorations, Christmas Trees, Shop by Christmas Theme) - the only seasonal branch in that menu. Followed through to the /en-gb/christmas hub, which carries a full category-tree with exact per-category product counts (site's own 'N Results' PLP totals), confirmed by visiting each category's own PLP page directly. Site-wide sitemap-categories.xml (fetched via in-page fetch()) was swept for christmas/halloween/easter/valentine/diwali/navratri/eid/hanukkah/st-patrick/thanksgiving/mothers-day/fathers-day/festive/advent/wreath/nutcracker/stocking keywords: ONLY Christmas-related and one Father's Day category slug exist anywhere on the site - Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, Diwali, Navratri, Eid, Hanukkah, St Patrick's Day, Thanksiving, New Year and Mother's Day have zero category pages in the sitemap (confirmed absent, not just a null internal-search result). Father's Day: /en-gb/gifts/fathers-day-gifts exists in the sitemap under the Gifts department but content-verified as 'No results / Please look for another category' (empty PLP, out of season) - excluded, does not satisfy 'lists products'. Scope discipline (Home & Furniture only, not fashion/beauty/food): excluded Christmas Food (/christmas/food, Food & Wine dept, 'Luxury Christmas Food | Christmas Snacks'), Christmas Drinks (/christmas/drinks, Food & Wine dept), Christmas Cards (/christmas/cards, stationery, not home decor), Christmas Hampers (/hampers/christmas-hampers*, Food & Wine dept gift hampers), Beauty Advent Calendars (/beauty-gift-sets/beauty-advent-calendars, Beauty dept), Holiday Shop (/holiday-shop/*, a Fashion 'vacation/resortwear' shop - mens/womens shorts, sandals, bikinis, sunglasses - not a holiday/festival category despite the word 'Holiday'), and Stocking Fillers (/gifts/stocking-fillers, cross-department small-gift category dominated by fragrance/jewellery, not home decor - distinct from the genuine Christmas Stockings home-decor category which is included). Also excluded 'Shop by Theme' (/christmas/shop-by-theme, 936 results, same order of magnitude as the whole Christmas department's 1002 total) - it is a curatorial re-slicing of the SAME underlying Christmas catalogue by aesthetic look (Festive Favourites, Love Is, White Wonder, Land & Country, Merry Maritime, Court Order) rather than a distinct product-type category; its own children showed heavy overlap with the product-type branches already captured (e.g. every product-type PLP visited cross-referenced back into a 'Shop by Theme (N)' facet with a matching count), so it was treated as the shared-overlap case in rules SS13-14 and not double-counted. Grouping: 'Christmas' is the top grouping row (own PLP, 1002 Results, own product grid with pagination - not a pure nav shell). 'Christmas Decorations' (798 Results) and 'Christmas Tableware' (163 Results - note: the /en-gb/christmas hub facet showed 'Tableware (101)' but the live Tableware PLP itself consistently displayed '163 Results' on repeated visits; used the category's own displayed PLP total per the qty-priority rule) are themselves genuine PLPs AND umbrella nodes for further product-type children, so kept as grouping rows carrying their own real qty/link/evidence plus their child leaf rows (children do not sum exactly to the parent total - some products are cross-tagged across multiple sub-types, e.g. Baubles 582 + Ornaments 214 + Garlands 26 + Tree Skirts 7 + Tree Toppers 2 = 831 vs parent's own 798 - not summed, each recorded independently per rules). Christmas Advent Calendars (14 Results) has minor sub-facets (Traditional 6, Beauty 3, Wooden 1) that don't sum to 14 and one of which (Beauty) is out of Home & Furniture scope; kept as a single leaf row rather than fragmenting into low-count, partly out-of-scope sub-facets. No PDPs were opened; all classification was done from category/PLP pages and the site's own taxonomy.
